justification: Both are low-relief panels showing profile human-form figures in long garments with raised gesturing arms and a small handled/carried object, which is a generic correspondence at best. A shows a multi-figure narrative scene in two stacked registers with seated figures at tables and rows of small attendants plus a block of sign-like marks, while B shows a single, monumental winged bird-headed composite being filling the whole field — different subject, scale, and compositional scheme.
